FOLDER.NAME: RETAIL_EDW
FOLDER.DESCRIPTION: Fictional retail warehouse for Crawl demos

TABLEATTRIBUTE.NAME: Lookup Sql Override
TABLEATTRIBUTE.VALUE: SELECT CURRENCY_CD, RATE_DATE, NVL(RATE_TO_USD, 1) AS RATE_TO_USD FROM FX_DAILY_RATE WHERE RATE_DATE >= TRUNC(SYSDATE) - 7

TABLEATTRIBUTE.NAME: Sql Query
TABLEATTRIBUTE.VALUE: SELECT SKU, ITEM_DESC, DEPT_CD, UNIT_COST, LIST_PRICE, STATUS FROM MERCH_ITEM WHERE DEPT_CD NOT IN ('99', 'GC') AND ROWNUM <= 500000

GROUP.NAME: CHANGED
GROUP.EXPRESSION: NOT ISNULL(LKP_PRODUCT_KEY) AND (ITEM_DESC != LKP_ITEM_DESC OR MARGIN_TIER != LKP_MARGIN_TIER)

TRANSFORMFIELD.NAME: FISCAL_PERIOD
TRANSFORMFIELD.EXPRESSION: DECODE(TRUE, FISCAL_WEEK <= 4, 1, FISCAL_WEEK <= 8, 2, FISCAL_WEEK <= 13, 3, FISCAL_WEEK <= 17, 4, FISCAL_WEEK <= 21, 5, FISCAL_WEEK <= 26, 6, FISCAL_WEEK <= 30, 7, FISCAL_WEEK <= 34, 8, FISCAL_WEEK <= 39, 9, FISCAL_WEEK <= 43, 10, FISCAL_WEEK <= 47, 11, 12)

TRANSFORMFIELD.NAME: NET_AMT
TRANSFORMFIELD.EXPRESSION: GROSS_AMT_USD - DISC_AMT_USD - IIF(NOT ISNULL(MEMBER_NO) AND GROSS_AMT_USD > 100, ROUND(GROSS_AMT_USD * 0.02, 2), 0)

TRANSFORMFIELD.NAME: RESTOCK_FEE
TRANSFORMFIELD.EXPRESSION: IIF(CONDITION_CD = 'OPENED' AND DAYS_SINCE_SALE > 14 AND REASON_CD != 'DEF', ROUND(UNIT_NET * QTY * 0.15, 2), 0)

TABLEATTRIBUTE.NAME: Sql Query
TABLEATTRIBUTE.VALUE: SELECT F.MEMBER_NO, SUM(F.NET_AMT) SPEND_12M, COUNT(DISTINCT F.DATE_KEY) VISITS_12M, MAX(F.DATE_KEY) LAST_VISIT FROM FACT_SALES F, LOYALTY_MEMBER M WHERE F.MEMBER_NO = M.MEMBER_NO(+) AND F.DATE_KEY >= TO_NUMBER(TO_CHAR(ADD_MONTHS(SYSDATE, -12), 'YYYYMMDD')) GROUP BY F.MEMBER_NO

TABLEATTRIBUTE.NAME: Sql Query
TABLEATTRIBUTE.VALUE: SELECT P.PROMO_ID, F.PRODUCT_KEY SKU, SUM(F.QTY) UNITS, SUM(F.NET_AMT) PROMO_REVENUE FROM PROMO_CALENDAR P, FACT_SALES F WHERE F.DATE_KEY BETWEEN TO_NUMBER(TO_CHAR(P.START_DT, 'YYYYMMDD')) AND TO_NUMBER(TO_CHAR(P.END_DT, 'YYYYMMDD')) GROUP BY P.PROMO_ID, F.PRODUCT_KEY
